Plot Fst between pairs of populations

Source: R/diversity.R
plot_fst.Rd

A heatmap of the result of calc_fst(): darker squares mean populations are more similar, brighter squares mean they are more differentiated. Values are printed in the squares when there are few groups.

Usage

plot_fst(fst, title = "Pairwise Fst")

Arguments

fst

The result of calc_fst().

title

Plot title.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

example_lct |>
  filter_snps() |>
  keep_pops(pop = c("YRI", "LWK", "GBR", "FIN", "CHB", "JPT")) |>
  calc_fst() |>
  plot_fst()
